'''G-5KN''' was a [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He informed a passerby of a threat posed by the [[Locust]] and asked to eliminate him.
